description: This source file defines an Android NFC card emulation service (`CardService`) that extends `HostApduService`. It handles incoming APDU commands related to NFC AID selection and responds with a loyalty account number or appropriate status words.

classes.name: CardService
classes.description: A subclass of HostApduService that processes NFC APDU commands for card emulation, including selecting an AID and retrieving account information.

methods.name: onDeactivated
methods.description: Handles NFC deactivation events, overridden but empty in this implementation.

methods.name: processCommandApdu
methods.description: Processes incoming APDU commands, matches SELECT AID commands, and sends back account details or error codes.

methods.name: BuildSelectApdu
methods.description: Constructs a SELECT APDU command byte array for a given AID.

methods.name: ByteArrayToHexString
methods.description: Converts a byte array to a hexadecimal string.

methods.name: HexStringToByteArray
methods.description: Converts a hexadecimal string to a byte array.

methods.name: ConcatArrays
methods.description: Concatenates multiple byte arrays into a single byte array.
